eval_data.answer:
try:
        text = wikipedia.page(page_title).content
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"An error occured: {e}")
        return None
    wordcloud = WordCloud().generate(text)
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
    plt.imshow(wordcloud, interpolation='bilinear')
    plt.axis('off')
    ax = plt.gca()
    return ax
